6pc Silicone pods 6pc Red Tops egg pods holder silicone oil brush silicone pop up spoon Instruction Guide
Instructions for using the Silicone Egg Cooker

1.Assemble the silicone pods and wash them with hot water before the first use. Dry them out with a cloth or napkin before use 2.Spray or add cooking oil to the silicone pods (use the provided silicone brush). 3.Crack the egg into the pod without the shell. You can add one jumbo egg or 2 small ones. Do not over pour the silicone pod. 4.Close the tops screwing them nice and tide 5.Boil the eggs for 10-15 min in a regular kitchen pot using the egg pods holder for best results (You can check them if they are ready by taking them out and basically touch the bottom of the silicone pod. 6.Take them out, unscrew the red tops and gently squeeze the bottom of the silicone pod so you can get the egg out. (You can help yourself by using the provided silicone spoon). The eggs should come out of the pod easy with no hassle. 7.Enjoy your hard boiled eggs, egg whites, small omelets, deviled eggs, egg salads.... 8.Wash the egg cooker set hard boiled with hot water or place it into the dish washer. 9.Do not use the egg maker in the microwave.
